record.reason: 要旨の対象はNIDS/ phishing / model capability benchmark / ViT transformer hardwareであり、LLM inference/serving efficiencyの研究ではない。 Primary abstract: Network intrusion detection remains challenging due to the wide variability of network traffic, where small to medium single-model approaches often fail to capture diverse attack patterns and large models are computationally expensive to deploy. This paper proposes a supervised Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework with reinforcement learning (RL)-based routing
record.title: Supervised Mixture-of-Experts with Deep Neural Network Routing via Reinforcement Learning for Scalable Network Intrusion Detection Systems
